WITH active AS (
  SELECT pa.id, pa.entity, pa.application_type, pa.expediente_id, pa.status,
         pa.submitted_at, pa.expected_response_days, pa.last_checked_at, pa.status_url, pa.notes,
         p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name,
         CASE
           WHEN pa.submitted_at IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE pa.submitted_at + (pa.expected_response_days || ' days')::interval
         END AS expected_resolution,
         CASE
           WHEN pa.last_checked_at IS NULL THEN 999
           ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pa.last_checked_at))/86400
         END AS days_since_check,
         CASE
           WHEN pa.submitted_at IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - (pa.submitted_at + (pa.expected_response_days || ' days')::interval)))/86400
         END AS days_overdue
    FROM permit_applications pa
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = pa.project_id
   WHERE pa.status NOT IN ('approved','rejected','withdrawn','expired')
     AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('completed','archived')
)
SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
  'permit_id', id, 'project_id', project_id, 'project_name', project_name,
  'entity', entity, 'application_type', application_type, 'expediente_id', expediente_id,
  'status', status, 'submitted_at', submitted_at, 'status_url', status_url,
  'expected_resolution', expected_resolution, 'days_since_check', round(days_since_check::numeric, 1),
  'days_overdue', round(days_overdue::numeric, 1),
  'priority', CASE
    WHEN days_overdue IS NOT NULL AND days_overdue > 0 THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN days_overdue IS NOT NULL AND days_overdue > -7 THEN 'due_soon'
    WHEN days_since_check > 14 THEN 'stale_check'
    ELSE 'normal'
  END
) ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN days_overdue IS NOT NULL AND days_overdue > 0 THEN 0
       WHEN days_overdue IS NOT NULL AND days_overdue > -7 THEN 1
       WHEN days_since_check > 14 THEN 2
       ELSE 3 END,
  days_overdue DESC NULLS LAST
) AS pending
FROM active;
SELECT value FROM system_config WHERE key = 'architect_email'
